For an established med spa like Aesthetic Renewal in New Jersey, I'd avoid generic "Summer Botox Sale" ads. Those attract price shoppers. Instead, position it around seasonal goals, confidence, and limited-time treatment bundles.

Here are several concepts that tend to perform well on Meta:

### 1. Summer Refresh Campaign (My favorite)
**Headline:**
Your Summer Refresh Starts Here

**Primary Text:**
Longer days. More photos. More vacations.

Whether you're heading to the beach or simply want to feel more confident, now is the perfect time to refresh your skin.

This month only, enjoy exclusive seasonal pricing on our most requested treatments.

✨ Botox
✨ Dermal Fillers
✨ HydraFacial
✨ Medical Grade Facials
✨ Laser Treatments

Book your complimentary consultation today before summer appointments fill up.

**CTA:** Book Now

---

### 2. Mid-Summer Glow Up

**Headline:**
Glow All Summer Long

**Primary Text:**
Healthy skin never goes out of style.

Whether you're preparing for weddings, vacations, or simply want to love what you see in the mirror, our providers will create a customized treatment plan just for you.

☀️ Limited-time summer specials
☀️ Personalized recommendations
☀️ Natural-looking results

Schedule your consultation today.

---

### 3. Summer Confidence Event

**Headline:**
Your Best Summer Starts Here

**Primary Text:**
Confidence looks good on everyone.

Join us for our Summer Confidence Event and receive exclusive savings on select aesthetic treatments for a limited time.

Whether you're interested in wrinkle relaxers, skin rejuvenation, or facial balancing, our experienced team is here to help.

Appointments are limited.

---

### 4. Vacation Ready

**Headline:**
Vacation Ready Skin Starts Now

**Primary Text:**
Don't wait until the week before vacation.

The best aesthetic results happen with a little planning.

Book now for:
• Botox
• Fillers
• HydraFacials
• Laser Skin Rejuvenation
• Medical Skincare

Get vacation-ready with a customized treatment plan.

---

### 5. Skin Reboot

**Headline:**
Your Skin Worked Hard This Summer

**Primary Text:**
Sun. Heat. Sweat. Travel.

Summer can take a toll on your skin.

Restore hydration, improve texture, and bring back your glow with our physician-guided skin rejuvenation treatments.

Limited summer pricing available through the end of the month.

---

## Lead Magnet Idea (This is what I'd actually run)

Instead of advertising discounts, advertise a consultation with value.

**Headline:**
Discover Your Personalized Summer Glow Plan

**Primary Text:**
Most people don't need more treatments.
They need the right treatment.

Book a complimentary aesthetic consultation and receive:

✔ Customized treatment roadmap
✔ Skin analysis
✔ Provider recommendations
✔ Exclusive summer-only savings

No pressure. Just expert guidance tailored to your goals.

This typically generates higher-quality leads because people are booking for expertise rather than just chasing a coupon.

I'd also recommend layering these offers with Meta's new Advantage+ campaign structure, using short vertical videos of providers speaking directly to camera, before-and-after results (where compliant), and patient testimonials. That combination generally outperforms static graphics alone for local med spa lead generation.
